integrity: The included complete C++17 and Python sources, regenerated count tables, optimum partition masks and symmetry-orbit representatives allow direct reproduction of every reported coefficient and optimal orbit.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification for two specific labelled twelve-vertex graphs; no extension to other Archimedean graphs or higher orders, publication priority provisional. The proof relies on complete finite enumeration and a separately implemented cross-check; independent scholarly validation has not occurred.
title: Exact coalition spectra of the two twelve-vertex Archimedean graphs
